items.title: PHP ships emergency patches for critical PHP2Shell flaws
items.snippet: The PHP security team released emergency security patches for two critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) tracked collectively as PHP2Shell. [...]
items.summary: PHP’s security team released emergency patches for two critical remote code execution vulnerabilities collectively tracked as PHP2Shell.
items.why: Defenders should identify affected PHP systems and apply the emergency patches.

Experts say there are working exploits for the flaws, and that these cr
items.summary: Krebs on Security says many websites need core software updates for two vulnerabilities that could let attackers take control of affected servers.
items.why: Check PHP and other core software versions, and prioritize updates.

items.title: Threat Brief: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP: CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619
items.snippet: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 are Critical vulnerabilities in PHP, a scripting language used globally for web servers and CMS systems. The post Threat Brief: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP: CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619 appeared first on Unit 42 .
items.summary: Unit 42 identifies CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 as critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting software used for web servers and CMS systems.

items.title: Hundreds of websites taken offline as concern grows over two PHP vulnerabilities
items.snippet: The maintainers of the globally used PHP scripting language released patches for two vulnerabilities after alerting users that the bugs were severe.
items.summary: The Record reports that hundreds of websites have gone offline after PHP maintainers released patches for two severe vulnerabilities.
items.why: Prioritize patching PHP systems and check websites for service disruption.

items.title: ClickFix has never been bigger, and AI tools are its most convincing lure yet
items.snippet: ClickFix attacks are surging as cybercriminals use fake AI installers, malicious search results, and trusted chatbot platforms to trick users into executing malware. Push Security examines how these attacks evade traditional defenses and why AI tools have become increasingly effective lures. [...]
items.summary: BleepingComputer reports that ClickFix attacks use fake AI installers, malicious search results, and chatbot platforms to trick users into running malware.
items.why: Warn users against running installers or commands from unverified search results and chatbots.

items.summary: Microsoft released PowerToys 0.102 with two mouse utilities, command-line tools, and Command Palette improvements.
items.why: Review the new utilities and tools before adopting them in managed environments.

items.title: Microsoft says October updates didn’t actually fix VPN issues
items.snippet: Microsoft says it mistakenly flagged a bug causing Always On VPN connection issues as fixed in the October 2026 Windows 11 cumulative updates. [...]
items.summary: Microsoft says it mistakenly marked the Always On VPN connection issue as fixed in October 2026 Windows 11 updates.
items.why: Check whether Always On VPN remains affected after the October updates.

items.title: ‘Context Bombs’ Cut AI Attack Success by Misleading Agents With Fake Targets
items.snippet: Deceptive prompts lure AI agents into decoys and dead ends, cutting attack success by up to 91% in tests and raising the cost of a successful attack 23-fold. The post ‘Context Bombs’ Cut AI Attack Success by Misleading Agents With Fake Targets appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.summary: SecurityWeek reports tests in which deceptive prompts directed AI agents to fake targets, reducing attack success and increasing the cost of successful attacks.
items.why: Consider decoy targets as a way to mislead AI agents, while assessing the test claims.

items.title: High-Severity Flaws Exploited in Three Days as Ransomware Dominates Q3: Rapid7
items.snippet: Rapid7’s Q3 analysis finds high-severity flaws exploited within three days on average, while AI appeared in just 8% of tracked incidents. The post High-Severity Flaws Exploited in Three Days as Ransomware Dominates Q3: Rapid7 appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.summary: Rapid7’s Q3 analysis says high-severity flaws were exploited within three days on average, while AI appeared in 8% of tracked incidents.
items.why: Prioritize rapid assessment and remediation of high-severity vulnerabilities.

items.snippet: Militaries have spent more than a century operating with fuel and ammunition as limits of combat endurance. They are only beginning to treat batteries with the same operational seriousness, as small unmanned systems move from niche equipment to mass-consumption weapons. Recent bipartisan supply diversification efforts
items.summary: War on the Rocks argues militaries are beginning to treat batteries as a limit on drone endurance as small unmanned systems become more widespread.
items.why: Battery supply affects the endurance and sustained use of small drones.

items.summary: The US Marine Corps made the AI-enabled Maven battlefield management system available to all service commands and organizations.

items.title: Europe weighs giving utilities, infrastructure companies more powers to bring down drones
items.snippet: Offials are worried that drone attacks could knock out power to millions of people — as has happened frequently in Ukraine after Russian strikes.
items.summary: Defense News reports that Europe is weighing greater powers for utilities and infrastructure companies to bring down drones amid concerns about attacks on power supplies.
items.why: The debate concerns who can counter drones threatening critical infrastructure.

items.title: Russian attacks on Ukrainian civilians may have a domestic dimension

items.summary: Atlantic Council authors argue Russian attacks on Ukrainian civilians may aim to make parts of the country unlivable and serve a domestic propaganda purpose.
items.why: The analysis connects attacks on civilian areas with domestic messaging.
